findings.currentTarget: Marauder: Mungkin aku sempat ingin masuk ke rumahmu untuk mengambil sesuatu, tapi di sini masih ada orang hidup.

findings.objectiveReason: Doctor addresses the player formally and uses saya throughout the same account and nearby branch lines; aku in this otherwise formal line breaks the established character voice without a Russian address change.

findings.objectiveReason: The Russian гадёныш is a direct contemptuous insult in her threat scene; makhluk kecil reduces it to a neutral creature label and loses her abuse.

findings.category: Lost person framed as something the player made disappear
findings.objectiveReason: Russian что же ты потерял asks what Luka lost in a family-death conversation. Indonesian kauhilangkan assigns him agency for making it disappear rather than experiencing a loss.
findings.currentTarget: Lalu apa yang telah kauhilangkan?
findings.proposedTarget: Lalu apa yang sudah hilang dari hidupmu?

findings.category: Collective moral subject changed to third person
findings.objectiveReason: In the adjacent reflection on people fighting and killing, Russian сами не живём и другим не дадим includes the speaker in a collective we. Indonesian mereka shifts both clauses to other people and adds a claim that they do not want to live.
findings.currentTarget: Fugitive: Tapi begitulah, mereka sendiri tidak mau hidup dan tidak membiarkan orang lain hidup.
findings.proposedTarget: Fugitive: Tapi tidak, kita sendiri tak hidup, dan orang lain pun tak kita biarkan hidup.

findings.category: Fanatic idiom rendered as spatial distance
findings.objectiveReason: Russian ДАЛЕКО НЕ ВСЁ says much more is still to come; Indonesian MASIH JAUH DARI SEMUANYA reads as distance from everything and fails to convey the threat. The preceding line calls this only the beginning.
findings.currentTarget: Fanatic: Dan percayalah, kawanku, ini MASIH JAUH DARI SEMUANYA.
findings.proposedTarget: Fanatic: Dan percayalah, kawanku, ini JAUH DARI SELESAI.

findings.objectiveReason: The question quotes быть готовым (being ready), answered in the next line by Быть готовым – это значит / Siap berarti. Bersiap asks about preparing and breaks that question-answer relation.
findings.currentTarget: Apa artinya «bersiap»?
findings.proposedTarget: Apa artinya «menjadi siap»?

findings.category: Possessor of voices changed to player
findings.objectiveReason: This is the player response about WheelChair’s voices in his head, explicitly identified by him in his earlier line. Kepalaku makes the player claim to hear the voices instead.

findings.category: Childish sudden-action interjection rendered as gunshot
findings.objectiveReason: The daughter describes her friend suddenly doing a пакость (mischievous act). Russian бац! marks a sudden turn; Indonesian dor! specifically evokes a gunshot and jahat makes the act more severe than the surrounding friendship scene.
findings.currentTarget: Daughter: Lalu, dor! Dia melakukan sesuatu yang jahat!
findings.proposedTarget: Daughter: Lalu, tiba-tiba—bam!—dia melakukan hal jahil!

findings.objectiveReason: The cultist says how frightening it is to know that one will soon die, referring to his own imminent death. The draft repeats Anda inside the death clause and makes the addressed player the one soon to die.

findings.category: Body-part referent changed from hands to teeth

findings.proposedTarget: BigLebowski: Kuingatkan, kalau kau merencanakan sesuatu yang buruk, aku sendiri yang akan menonjok matamu sampai copot!
